text:
raj_oncall: incident-bot just paged us for a p99 spike on streaming decode in us-west-1. starts ~14:23 UTC. multiple customer sessions seeing stalls.
incident-bot: [ALERT] streaming-decode-usw1 p99>1200ms, tail error increase, paging_count up 8x. auto-notify: eng-oncall, eng-sre.
matt_runtime: looking at node pools now. top-of-stack shows sudden major pagefaults on decode worker processes after today's node kernel bump (6.2.30).
kevin_sre: I see the same. dmesg spam: "page allocation failure" and vmstat shows huge kswap activity. this smells like a kernel+compilepath interaction with our allocator.
lina_platform: which deploy rolled recently? buildbot shows a TRT/flashattn library rebuild yesterday and we rolled a kernel package to nodes this morning.
sara_ops: customer-impact: at least 3 mid-market customers report timeouts on live streaming, fallback to polling causing UX issues. CS alerted.
pm_olivia: please quantify SLO impact (p95/p99) and list affected customers for priority outreach.
matt_runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from pool to older nodes (canary in eu/west) 2) hot rollback kernel to 6.2.29 3) apply decode runtime flag to disable prefetch/eviction heuristic.
kevin_sre: routing first. Lina, can you shift traffic from pool decode-usw1-pool-b to pool-a? we need immediate relief.
lina_platform: on it, creating temporary routing rule to divert 40% now, ramping to 100% over 2m if p99 improves.
incident-bot: routing-change: traffic-divert job started by lina_platform.
matt_runtime: while routing ramps, preparing a hotpatch to change compile flags: 
```
# tentative hotpatch
export DECODE_COMPILE_FLAGS='-DSTREAM_PREFETCH=0 -DUSE_SMALLER_BINS'
systemctl restart decode-runtime
```
kevin_sre: i'm standing by to roll kernel rollback if routing doesn't drop p99 within 3m. Raj, please coordinate customer comms.
raj_oncall: will prepare a short blurb for CS and SOC: "We're investigating streaming latency spike impacting some customers in us-west-1. Mitigations underway: routing and runtime patches. ETA 30-60m."
sara_ops: add list of impacted org IDs: A-123, B-987, C-555 (from support queue).
matt_runtime: quick log excerpt from a hung decode proc: 
```
[decode-worker pid=2314] trace: access_page at 0x7f3a... ret=SIGSEGV
vmstat: si 0 so 0 in 10s; pgfaults major 120 -> 950 in 5m
kernel: kallsyms: slab corruption? calling kmem_cache_free
```
kevin_sre: that slab note could be a red-herring, but consistent with allocator churn after a kernel virt-memory change. rolling kernel rollback will be intrusive (reboots). prefer routing+hotpatch first.
lina_platform: routing ramp complete, now at 100% diverted. metrics watch: p99 dropped from ~1300ms -> 420ms. p95 back to baseline.
pm_olivia: good — please hold CS note until we confirm stable for 10m. thanks.
matt_runtime: applying runtime flag to one canary node now, will monitor.
incident-bot: metric-check in 2m.
kevin_sre: if canary still shows improvements, schedule kernel rollback during maintenance window for remaining nodes (coord with infra).
raj_oncall: handing off to oncall-night (sara_ops) in 30m — will include runbook: steps to verify p99, routing rollback, kernel rollback commands and customer list.
sara_ops: ack, I'll take it and continue monitoring. leave any open PRs in the thread. :+1:
pm_olivia: action items: (1) customer outreach draft, (2) postmortem owner? matt_runtime volunteers.
matt_runtime: volunteering for postmortem — will gather logs, kernel hashes, compile flags and timeline.
kevin_sre: filing a follow-up to correlate kernel package hash -> allocator behavior. also will prepare rollback playbook.
raj_oncall: closing page for now — mitigation successful via routing+hotpatch canary. if p99 creeps up again, escalate to rollback. last note: track number of affected sessions and link to CS tickets.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): streaming-decode-usw1. severity lowered to P3.
